identify_intro.title: Identify the Reef
identify_intro.body: Tap a species you can see in this photo. Your identification helps real scientists studying Caribbean reefs.

egg_intro.title: New Hatchling
egg_intro.body: A breeding event! Tap the egg to hatch it, then drag the fish into your reef.

end_turn_action.title: End the Turn
end_turn_action.body: Press End Turn. Your fish will help the coral grow — one turn is all you need.
